passages.provision_quote: a public school that receives funds under such Act shall obtain parental consent before changing a covered student's-- (1) gender markers, pronouns, or preferred name on any school form
passages.note: Sec. 2 matches the parental-permission rung's text, but the bill also bars ESEA funds for teaching gender ideology (Sec. 3), and at the federal level only own words can seat a chair on this topic.
Roll Call 184, On Passage of H.R. 2616; Kennedy (UT) voted Aye; a record cannot seat a chair at this no-lever level.

rows.reasoning: The only evidence is his Aye on final passage of H.R. 2616, whose Sec. 2 requires schools to "obtain parental consent before changing a covered student's-- (1) gender markers, pronouns, or preferred name", close to the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns." But the federal level holds no lever on this topic, so only his own words can seat a chair, and no own-words passage is in the sources.
